create.name: Kathleen Booker
create.bio:
Kathleen Booker is a breathwork facilitator and energy guide who calls herself the Jedi of Calm. She works with conscious connected breathwork, a practice of continuous, unbroken breathing done lying down, and uses it to help people slow down, steady themselves and feel what they are carrying rather than push it away. Her approach is warm and direct, and she presents the breath as an anchor that is always available, whether someone is celebrating, grieving a loss or simply getting through an ordinary busy week. She counts Iyanla Vanzant among her teachers.

She offers one-to-one breathwork and energy sessions, and for organisations she leads workshops on staying grounded under pressure, clarifying personal values and leading with both heart and mind. For women she teaches a seven-week online course on breathwork as a route to self-love, personal empowerment and a sense of divine connection, hosted by The Shift Network. Short recorded breathwork meditations of five to thirty minutes are sold on her website, a free session is sent to people who join her mailing list, and she speaks on podcasts and at retreats.

courses.title: Breath as a Pathway to Self-Love, Personal Empowerment & Divine Connection
courses.description: A seven-week online course for women in conscious connected breathwork, led by Kathleen through The Shift Network. Each week uses the breath to build self-worth, confidence and a felt connection with the sacred.

courses.title: One-to-One Breathwork and Energy Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions in which Kathleen guides breathwork and energy work suited to what you are going through. The aim is to clear mental and emotional clutter and find a steadier centre.

courses.title: Corporate Breathwork Workshops
courses.description: Workshops for teams and leaders on staying calm under pressure, working from shared values and communicating with presence. Kathleen teaches simple breathing tools that can be used during the working day.

courses.title: Breathwork Meditation: Full Body (30 minutes)
courses.description: A recorded half-hour breathwork meditation that moves attention through the whole body. A downloadable audio to use at home whenever you need it.

courses.title: Breathwork Meditation: The Heart (10 minutes)
courses.description: A ten-minute recorded breathwork practice centred on the heart. Sold as a download from her shop.

courses.title: Breathwork Meditation: Quiet the Mind (5 minutes)
courses.description: A five-minute recorded breathing practice for settling a busy mind. A short download for a quick pause in the day.

courses.title: Breathwork Meditation: Remembering Who You Are (5 minutes)
courses.description: A five-minute recorded breathwork meditation about reconnecting with your own sense of self. Available as a download.

free_resources.title: Free Breathwork Session
free_resources.description: A free guided breathwork session from Kathleen, sent by email when you join her mailing list. A short practice for coming back to centre at any time.
